# core/text.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/text.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

Building byte strings. A text under construction is a
`Vec[u8]`, which grows as bytes are pushed; `text_finish` turns it into
`Bytes`.

What is proved: each push adds exactly the given bytes at the end and
leaves the earlier ones alone (spec fn `text_keeps`), and `text_to_bytes`
copies every byte. The `fmt_*` functions of core/num.bastio keep the
earlier bytes too.

`import "core/text.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`text_new`](#text_new) | An empty text. |
| [`text_push`](#text_push) | Appends one byte. |
| [`text_push_str`](#text_push_str) | Appends the bytes of a literal. |
| [`text_push_span`](#text_push_span) | Appends bytes `from..to` of `b`. |
| [`text_push_bytes`](#text_push_bytes) | Appends all of `b`. |
| [`text_to_bytes`](#text_to_bytes) | A `Bytes` copy of `t`. |
| [`text_finish`](#text_finish) | Consumes `t` and returns its bytes. |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `text_new`

```bastio
fn text_new() -> Vec[u8]
  ensures vlen(result) == 0
```

An empty text.

Example:

```bastio
let mut t = text_new();
text_push_str(&mut t, "id=");
text_push(&mut t, 55);   // '7'
assert vlen(t) == 4 && vget(t, 3) == 55;
let b = text_finish(t);
let ok = bytes_eq_str(b, "id=7");
bfree(b);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `text_push`

```bastio
fn text_push(t: &mut Vec[u8], c: u8)
  ensures vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + 1 && vget(t, vlen(old(t))) == c
  ensures text_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
```

Appends one byte.

### `text_push_str`

```bastio
fn text_push_str(t: &mut Vec[u8], s: Str)
  ensures vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + slen(s)
  ensures text_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < slen(s) ==> vget(t, vlen(old(t)) + k) == sget(s, k)
```

Appends the bytes of a literal.

### `text_push_span`

```bastio
fn text_push_span(t: &mut Vec[u8], b: &Bytes, from: u64, to: u64)
  requires from <= to && to <= blen(b)
  ensures vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + (to - from)
  ensures text_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures text_same_at(t, vlen(old(t)), b, from, to - from)
```

Appends bytes `from..to` of `b`.

Example:

```bastio
let line = bfrom("user: yuki");
let mut t = text_new();
text_push_str(&mut t, "hello, ");
text_push_span(&mut t, line, 6, 10);
text_push_bytes(&mut t, line);
assert vlen(t) == 7 + 4 + 10;
let b = text_to_bytes(t);
let ok = bytes_eq_str(b, "hello, yukiuser: yuki");
bfree(b);
vec_free(t);
bfree(line);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `text_push_bytes`

```bastio
fn text_push_bytes(t: &mut Vec[u8], b: &Bytes)
  ensures vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + blen(b)
  ensures text_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures text_same_at(t, vlen(old(t)), b, 0, blen(b))
```

Appends all of `b`.

### `text_to_bytes`

```bastio
fn text_to_bytes(t: &Vec[u8]) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == vlen(t)
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < vlen(t) ==> bget(result, k) == vget(t, k)
```

A `Bytes` copy of `t`.

### `text_finish`

```bastio
fn text_finish(t: Vec[u8]) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == vlen(t)
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < vlen(t) ==> bget(result, k) == vget(t, k)
```

Consumes `t` and returns its bytes.

## Specification functions

### `text_same_at`

```bastio
spec fn text_same_at(t: &Vec[u8], i: u64, b: &Bytes, j: u64, n: u64) -> bool {
  forall k: u64 :: k < n ==> vget(t, i + k) == bget(b, j + k)
}
```

`t[i..i+n]` holds the bytes `b[j..j+n]`.

### `text_keeps`

```bastio
spec fn text_keeps(t: &Vec[u8], u: &Vec[u8], n: u64) -> bool {
  forall k: u64 :: k < n ==> vget(t, k) == vget(u, k)
}
```

`t` and `u` agree below `n`.
